answer: A Dedicated device bound by callback verification with annual re-verification ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. Auditors look for the opal that does not belong: a channel with no owner behind it. When the tide settles over the pearl, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
